zh: 接着，又有疑问∶『这个罚捐，要不要出奏？』他问，『你意下如何？』『出奏呢，怕有人反对，办不成功；不出奏呢？又怕将来部里打官腔，或者「都老爷」参上一本。』胡雪岩说，『利弊参见，全在大人作主。』『办是一定要办；不过我虽不怕事，却犯不上无缘无故背个黑锅，你倒再想想，有什么既不怕他人掣肘，又能为自己留下退步的办法。』『凡事只要秉公办理，就一定会有退步。我想，开办之先，不必出奏；办得有了成效，再奏明收捐的数目，以后直接咨部备案，作为将来报销的根据。』『好！准定这样办。』左宗棠大为赞赏∶『「凡事只要秉公办理，就必有退步。」这话说得太好了。不过，你所说的「成效」也很要紧；国家原有上千万的银子，经常封存内库，就为的是供大征伐之用。这笔巨款，为赛尚阿之流的那班旗下大爷挥霍一空；所以「皇帝不差饿兵」那句俗语，不适用了！如今朝廷不但差的是饿兵，要各省自己筹饷；而且要协解「京饷」。如果说，我们办得有成效的税捐，不准再办；那好，请朝廷照数指拨一笔的款好了。』这番话说到尽头了；胡雪岩对左宗棠的处境、想法、因应之道亦由这番话中有了更深的了解。只要不是伤天害理，任何筹饷的办法，都可以得到他的同意。
en: Another question followed. “Should this penalty contribution be reported to the throne? What do you think?” “If it is reported first, opposition may prevent the scheme from starting. If it is not, the ministry may later raise procedural objections, or a censor may impeach us. There are advantages and disadvantages on both sides. Your Excellency must decide.” “It must be done. But though I am not afraid of trouble, there is no reason to take the blame unnecessarily. Think again: is there a way to prevent interference while leaving us a defensible position?” “Act impartially in the public interest, and there will always be a way to defend ourselves. I suggest not reporting before we begin. Once the scheme has produced results, memorialise the throne with the amounts collected. Thereafter, notify the ministry directly for its records, providing the basis for the eventual accounting.” “Good! We shall do exactly that.” Zuo was delighted. “‘Act impartially in the public interest, and there will always be a way to defend ourselves’—very well said. But the results you mention are important too. The state once kept more than ten million taels sealed in the inner treasury for major campaigns. That great sum was squandered by Saishang’a and his fellow Banner grandees. So the saying ‘The emperor does not send hungry soldiers on his errands’ no longer applies. Now the court not only sends hungry soldiers and requires each province to find its own military funds; it also demands remittances for the capital’s military expenses. If we establish a productive tax or contribution and are forbidden to continue it, very well: let the court assign us a reliable source for the same amount.” That brought his argument to its conclusion. Hu now understood more deeply Zuo’s position, his thinking and his response to circumstances. Any method of raising military funds that was not utterly wicked could gain his approval.

zh: 胡雪岩在左宗棠行辕中盘桓了两天，才回杭州。归来的这番风光，与去时大不相同；左宗棠派亲兵小队护送，自不在话下，最使他惊异的是，到了武林门外，发现有一班很体面的人在迎接，一大半是杭州的绅干，包括张秀才在内；其余的都穿了官服，胡雪岩却一个都不认识。此外，还有一顶绿呢大轿，放在城门洞里；更不知作何用处？胡雪岩颇为困惑，『是接我的吗？』他问何都司。不用何都司回答，看到刘不才和小张；胡雪岩知道接自己是不错的了。果然，小张笑容满面地奔了上来。一把拉住马头上的嚼环，高声说道∶『这里前天晚上就得消息了！盼望大驾真如火旱之望云霓！』是何消息？盼望他回来又为何如此殷切？胡雪岩正待动问，却不待他开口；首先是一名武巡捕在马前打躬，同时说道∶『请胡大人下马，换大轿吧！』『是这样的，』小张赶紧代为解释，『这是蒋方伯派来的差官；绿呢大轿是蒋方伯自己用的，特为来伺候。』『是！』那名武巡捕打开拜匣，将蒋益澧的一份名帖与一份请柬递了上来，『敝上派我来伺候胡大人；特为交代，本来要亲自来迎接，只为有几件紧要公事，立等结果，分不开身。敝上又说∶』请胡大人一到就会个面，有好些事等着商量。『这一说胡雪岩明白了，小张所说的』消息『，是指他奉委为善后局总办一事；大家如此殷切盼望，以及蒋益澧立等会面，当然是因为』万事莫如赈济急『，一切善后事宜，都待他来作了决定，方能动手兴办。
en: Hu remained at Zuo’s headquarters for two days before returning to Hangzhou. His homecoming was far more splendid than his departure. An escort of Zuo’s personal guards was only to be expected. What surprised him most, outside Wulin Gate, was a welcoming party of distinguished-looking men. More than half were active members of Hangzhou’s gentry, including Licentiate Zhang; the rest wore official robes, though Hu knew none of them. A great green-covered sedan chair stood in the gateway. What was that for? Puzzled, he asked Officer He, “Have they come to meet me?” Before He could answer, the sight of Liu Bucai and young Zhang settled the question. Zhang ran up beaming, caught the ring of his horse’s bridle and cried, “The news reached us the night before last! We have awaited you like clouds and rain in a scorching drought.” What news? Why such eagerness for his return? Before Hu could ask, a guard officer bowed before his horse. “Please dismount, Your Excellency, and take the sedan chair.” Young Zhang hurried to explain. “Treasurer Jiang sent this officer. The green-covered chair is his own, brought specially for you.” “Yes.” The officer opened a visiting-card box and presented Jiang’s card and invitation. “My superior sent me to attend you. He expressly instructed me to say that he intended to come himself, but several urgent matters require immediate decisions, and he cannot get away. He asks to see you as soon as you arrive. There is much awaiting discussion.” Hu understood. The “news” was his appointment as director of the reconstruction bureau. Everyone’s eagerness, and Jiang’s insistence on seeing him at once, arose naturally from the urgency of relief. The work of reconstruction awaited his decisions before it could begin.

zh: 领会及此，他觉得不宜先跟蒋益澧见面。但此刻的蒋益澧。『等于一省长官，这样殷勤相待，如果不领他的情，是件很失礼的事；必得找一个很好的借口才能敷衍得过去。他的心思很快，下马之顷，已想好一套说词，』拜烦回复贵上，『他说∶』我也急于要进见，有好些公事请示。不过，这几天来回奔波，身上脏得不成样子；这样子去见长官，太不恭敬。等我稍为抹一抹身子，换一套干净衣服，马上就去。贵上的绿呢大轿，不是我该坐的；不过却之不恭，请你关照轿班，空轿子跟着我去好了。『于是先到张家暂息，将善后应办的大事，以及要求蒋益澧支持的事项，写了个大概，方始应约赴宴。相见欢然，蒋益澧当面递了委札；胡雪岩便从身上掏出一张纸来，递了过去，上面写的是∶『善后急要事项』，一共七条∶第一、掩埋尸体，限半个月完竣。大兵之后大疫，此不仅为安亡魂，亦防疫疠。
en: Precisely for that reason, he thought it unwise to see Jiang first. Yet Jiang was now effectively the head of the province. To reject such attentive hospitality would be discourteous; only an excellent excuse would do. Hu thought quickly. By the time he dismounted, his answer was ready. “Please tell your superior that I too am anxious to pay my respects and seek his instructions on many matters. But after these days of travelling back and forth, I am disgracefully dirty. To visit a superior in this state would be disrespectful. Let me wash and change into clean clothes, and I shall come at once. His green-covered chair is not one I am entitled to ride in, but it would be rude to refuse his kindness. Please ask the bearers to follow me with it empty.” He went first to the Zhang house for a short rest and wrote an outline of the principal reconstruction measures and the support he needed from Jiang. Only then did he attend the banquet. They met warmly. Jiang handed him the letter of appointment, and Hu took out a sheet of paper in return. It was headed “Urgent Reconstruction Measures” and contained seven proposals. First: bury the dead within half a month. Great epidemics followed great wars; this would both give the departed rest and prevent disease.

zh: 第二、办理施粥，以半年为期。公家拨给米粮，交地方公正绅士监督办理。第三、凡粮食、衣着、砖瓦、木料等民生必需品类，招商贩运，免除厘税，以广招徕。第四、访查殉难忠烈，采访事迹，奏请建立昭忠祠。第五、贼营拔出妇女，访查其家，派妥人送回。第六、春耕关乎今年秋冬生计，应尽全力筹办。第七、恢复书院，优待士子。
en: Second: provide free porridge for six months. The government should supply the grain, while impartial local gentlemen supervised its distribution. Third: invite merchants to bring in food, clothing, bricks, tiles, timber and other necessities, exempting these goods from likin to encourage trade. Fourth: investigate those who had died loyally in the disaster, collect accounts of their deeds, and petition the throne for a shrine commemorating the loyal dead. Fifth: trace the families of women rescued from the rebel camps and send them home with trustworthy escorts. Sixth: make every effort to arrange spring cultivation, on which livelihoods in the coming autumn and winter depended. Seventh: reopen the academies and give favourable treatment to scholars.

zh: 『应该，应该！』蒋益澧说，『我无不同意。至于要人，或者要下委札，动公事，请雪翁告诉我，只要力之所及，一定如命。』『多谢芗翁成全浙江百姓。不过眼前有件事，无论如何要请芗翁格外支持。』胡雪岩率直说道∶『弟兄们的纪律一定要维持。』蒋益澧脸一红，他也知道他部下的纪律不好；不过，他亦有所辩解∶『说实话，弟兄们亦是饿得久了——。』『芗翁，』胡雪岩打断他的话说，『饷，我负责；军纪，请芗翁负责。』蒋益澧心想，胡雪岩现在直接可以见左宗棠，而且据说言听计从；倘或拿此事跟上面一说，再交下来，面子就不好看了。既然如此，不如自己下决心来办。于是他决定了两个办法∶一是出告示重申军纪，违者就地正法；二是他从第二天开始，整天坐镇杭州城中心的官巷口，亲自执行军法。这一来，纪律果然好得多了。善后事宜，亦就比较容易着手；只是苦了胡雪岩，一天睡不到三个时辰，身上掉了好几斤的肉，不过始终精神奕奕，毫无倦容。
en: “Quite right, quite right!” Jiang said. “I agree to everything. If you need men, appointments or official papers, tell me, Mr Xueyan. Whatever lies within my power shall be done.” “Thank you, Mr Xiang, for helping the people of Zhejiang. But there is one matter on which I must ask your exceptional support.” Hu spoke plainly. “The troops must be kept under discipline.” Jiang reddened. He knew his men’s discipline was poor, but offered a defence. “To be honest, the men have gone hungry for so long—” “Mr Xiang,” Hu interrupted, “I shall take responsibility for their pay. Please take responsibility for their discipline.” Jiang reflected that Hu could now see Zuo directly and was said to have all his advice accepted. If he raised the matter with their superior and an order came back down, Jiang would lose face. Better to resolve it himself. He therefore decided on two measures: a proclamation reaffirming military discipline, with offenders to be executed on the spot; and, from the next day, his own presence throughout the day at Guanxiangkou in the city centre to enforce military law personally. Discipline did indeed improve considerably, and reconstruction became easier to undertake. The burden fell on Hu, who slept fewer than three double-hours a day and lost several jin in weight. Yet he remained vigorous and showed no fatigue.

zh: 左宗棠是三月初二到省城的；一下了轿，约见的第一个人就是胡雪岩。『惨得很！』左宗棠脸上很少有那样沮丧的颜色，『军兴以来，我也到过好些地方；从没有见过杭州这样子遭劫的！以前杭州有多少人？』『八十一万。』胡雪岩答说。『现在呢？』『七万多。』『七万多？』左宗棠嗟叹着；忽然抬眼问道∶『雪翁，不说八万，不说六万，独说七万多；请问何所据而云然？』『这是大概的估计。不过，亦不是空口瞎说。』胡雪岩答道∶『是从各处施粥厂、平粜处发出的「筹子」算出来的。』『好极！』左示棠大为嘉许，『雪翁真正才大心细。照你看，现在办善后，当务之急是哪几样？』
en: Zuo reached the provincial capital on the second day of the third month. The first man he summoned after stepping from his chair was Hu. “Terrible!” There was an unusually dejected look on his face. “Since the war began, I have visited many places, but never seen one devastated like Hangzhou. What was its former population?” “Eight hundred and ten thousand.” “And now?” “A little over seventy thousand.” “A little over seventy thousand!” Zuo sighed. Then he looked up. “Mr Xueyan, you do not say eighty thousand or sixty thousand, but a little over seventy thousand. On what evidence?” “It is an estimate, but not an idle guess. I have calculated it from the tokens issued at the porridge kitchens and the places selling grain at reduced prices.” “Excellent!” Zuo was full of praise. “You truly combine great ability with care for detail. What do you consider the most urgent measures now?”

zh: 『当务之急，自然是振兴市面；市面要兴旺，全靠有人肯来做生意；做生意的人胆子小，如果大人有办法让他们放心大胆地到杭州来，市面就会浴量，百姓有了生路，公家的厘金税收，亦会增加。于公于私，都有莫大的好处。』『这无非在整饬纪律四个字，格外下功夫，你叫商人不要怕，尽管到杭州来做生意。如果吃了亏，准他们直接到我衙门来投诉；我一定严办。』『有大人这句话，他们就敢来了。』胡雪岩又问，『善后事宜，千头万绪，包罗太广；目前以赈抚为主，善后局是否可以改为赈抚局。』『不错！这个意见很好。』左宗棠随即下条子照办；一切如旧，只是换了个名字。赈抚局的公事，麻烦而琐碎，占去了胡雪岩许多的功夫；以致想见一次左宗棠，一直找不到适当的时间。
en: “Naturally, reviving trade. A market can flourish only if people are willing to come and do business. Merchants are timid. If Your Excellency can make them confident enough to come to Hangzhou, trade will revive, the people will have a livelihood, and public revenue from likin will rise. It will benefit both the government and the people enormously.” “That simply means taking still greater pains to enforce discipline. Tell the merchants not to be afraid. Let them come and trade in Hangzhou. If they suffer any wrong, they may complain directly at my office. I shall punish the offenders severely.” “With that assurance, they will dare come.” Hu added, “Reconstruction covers a vast range of matters. At present, relief and reassurance are the chief tasks. Might the reconstruction bureau be renamed the relief bureau?” “Yes. An excellent suggestion.” Zuo immediately issued a written instruction. Everything else remained as before; only the name changed. The bureau’s troublesome, minute affairs consumed so much of Hu’s time that he could never find a suitable opportunity for another meeting with Zuo.

zh: 这样迁延了半个月，专折奏报克复杭州的折差，已由京里回到杭州，为左宗棠个人带来一个好消息，『内阁奉口谕∶闽浙总督左宗棠自督办浙江军务以来，连克各府州县城池。兹复将杭州省城、余杭县城攻拔，实属调度有方。着加恩赏太子少保衔；并赏穿黄马褂。』此外，蒋益澧亦赏穿黄马褂∶『所有在事出力将士，着左宗棠查明，择优保奉。』消息一传，全城文武官员，够得上资格见总督的无不肃具衣冠，到总督行辕去叩圆。左宗棠穿上簇新的黄马褂，分班接见，慰勉有加；看到胡雪岩随着候补道员同班磕头，特为嘱咐戈什哈等在二堂门口，将他留了下来。等宾僚散尽，左宗棠在花厅与胡雪岩以便服相见。一见少不得再次致贺；左宗棠自道受恩深重，对朝廷益难报称，紧接着又向胡雪岩致歉，总克复杭州有功人员报奖，奏稿已经办好，即将拜发；其中并无胡雪岩的名字，因为第一次保案，只限于破城将士，以后奏保办理地方善后人员，一定将他列为首位。
en: Half a month passed in this way. Then the courier who had carried the special memorial announcing Hangzhou’s recovery returned from Beijing with good news for Zuo personally. “The Grand Secretariat has received an oral decree: Since taking charge of military affairs in Zhejiang, Zuo Zongtang, Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang, has successively recovered prefectural, subprefectural and county seats. He has now taken the provincial capital of Hangzhou and the county seat of Yuhang, demonstrating skilful direction. As a special favour, he is granted the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and permission to wear the yellow riding jacket.” Jiang Yili too received the yellow riding jacket. “Zuo Zongtang shall investigate the services of all officers and men involved and recommend the most deserving for reward.” When the news spread, every civil and military official in the city entitled to see the governor-general dressed in formal robes and went to headquarters to offer congratulations. Wearing his new yellow jacket, Zuo received them in groups with generous words of encouragement. When he saw Hu kowtowing with the expectant circuit intendants, he specially instructed a guard to wait at the second hall and detain him. After the guests and staff had dispersed, the two met in informal dress in the garden reception room. Hu naturally congratulated him again. Zuo spoke of the weight of imperial favour and how difficult it was to repay. Then he apologised: the memorial recommending rewards for the recovery of Hangzhou was already drafted and about to be sent, but Hu’s name was not in it. This first list was confined to those who had stormed the city. When the reconstruction staff were recommended later, Hu would certainly head the list.

zh: 胡雪岩自然要道谢，同时简单扼要地报告办理善后的进展，奉『以工代赈，振兴市面』八个字为宗旨，这样一方面办了赈济；一方面做了复旧的工作。左宗棠不断点头，表示满意。然后问起胡雪岩有何困难？『困难当然很多，言不胜言，也不敢麻烦大人；只要力所能及，我自会料理，请大人放心。不过，人无远虑，必有近忧；如今已经三月下旬了，转眼「五荒六月』；家家要应付眼前。青黄不接的当口，能够过得过去，都因为有个指望；指望秋天的收成，还了债好过年，大人，今年只怕难了！『一句话提醒了左宗棠，悚然而惊，搓着手说∶』是啊！秋收全靠春耕。目前正是插秧的时候，如果耽误了，可是件不得了的事！『』大人说这话，两浙的百姓有救了。『『你不要看得太容易，这件事着实要好好商量。雪翁，你看，劝农这件事，该怎么样做法？』
en: Hu thanked him and briefly reported progress. His guiding principles were “relief through work; revival through trade”, so that assistance to the needy also accomplished the work of restoration. Zuo nodded repeatedly in approval and asked what difficulties he faced. “There are naturally too many to recount. I would not trouble Your Excellency with them. Whatever I can manage, I shall attend to myself. But without foresight, trouble soon comes close. It is already late in the third month, and the hungry fifth and sixth months will be upon us before we know it. Every household must meet its immediate needs. In the gap between the old crop and the new, people endure because they have something to hope for: the autumn harvest, which will let them repay their debts and pass the New Year. Your Excellency, that may be difficult this year.” The words alerted Zuo. Startled, he rubbed his hands. “Yes! The autumn harvest depends on spring cultivation. This is the time to transplant rice seedlings. If we miss it, the consequences will be dreadful.” “With Your Excellency recognising that, the people of Zhejiang can be saved.” “Do not think it so easy. We must discuss it carefully. Mr Xueyan, how should we encourage cultivation?”

zh: 『大人古书读得多，历朝历代，都有大乱；大乱之后，怎么帮乡下人下田生产，想来总记得明明白白？』『啊，啊，言之有理。』左宗棠说，『我有，这方面是汉初办得好，薄太后的黄老之学，清静无为，才是真是与民休息。就不知道当今两宫太后，能否象薄太后那样？『胡雪岩不懂黄老之学，用于政务，便是无为而治；也不知道薄太后就是汉文帝的生母。不过清静无为、与民休息这两句成语是听得懂，便紧接着他的话说∶『真正再明白不过是大人！要荒了的田地有生气，办法也很简单。三个字∶不骚扰！大人威望如山，令出必行，只要下一道命令，百姓受惠无穷。』『当然，这道命令是一定要下的。雪翁，你且说一说，命令中要禁止些什么？』『是！』胡雪岩想了一下答说∶『第一、军饷的来源是厘金、是殷实大户的捐献，与种田的老百姓无干。今年的钱粮，想来大人总要奏请豁免的；就怕各县的「户书」假名追征旧欠。那一来，老百姓就吓得不敢下田了！』『那怎么行？』左宗棠神色凛然地，『若有此事，简直毫无心肝了，杀无赦！』
en: “Your Excellency has read the ancient books widely. Every dynasty has known great disorder. You must remember clearly how they helped country people return to their fields afterwards.” “Ah, yes. A sound observation. I do. The early Han handled this well. Empress Dowager Bo followed the teachings of the Yellow Emperor and Laozi: quietness and non-interference. That truly allowed the people to recover. I only wonder whether our present two empress dowagers can do as she did.” Hu did not understand how those teachings became government through non-action, nor did he know that Empress Dowager Bo was Emperor Wen’s mother. But he understood the familiar phrases “quietness and non-interference” and “allow the people to recover”, and took up Zuo’s point. “No one sees more clearly than Your Excellency. To bring life back to abandoned fields, the method is simple: do not disturb them. Your authority is as firm as a mountain; your orders are obeyed. One command will bring the people boundless benefit.” “Certainly. That command must be issued. Tell me what it should forbid.” “First,” Hu said after a moment’s thought, “military funds come from likin and contributions from wealthy households. They have nothing to do with ordinary farmers. I presume Your Excellency intends to seek remission of this year’s land taxes. My fear is that county revenue clerks may demand supposed arrears under false pretexts. That will frighten the people away from their fields.” “Impossible!” Zuo’s expression hardened. “Anyone who did that would be utterly heartless. He would be executed without pardon.”

zh: 『第二、怕弟兄们抓差拉夫。』『这也不会。我早就下令严禁；征差要给价。如今我可以重申前令，农忙季节，一律不准骚扰，而且还要保护。』左宗棠问道∶『还有呢？』『还有就是怕弟兄们杀耕牛！』『那也不会，谁杀耕牛，我就杀他。』『大人肯这样卫护百姓，今年秋收有望了。至于种籽、农具，我去备办；将来是由公家贷放，还是平价现卖，请大人定章 程。好在不管怎么样，东西早预备在那里，总是不错的！』『不错，不错。请你去预备，也要请你垫款。』左宗棠说道，『除了钱以外，我这里什么都好商量。』『是！』胡雪岩答道∶『我是除了钱以外，什么事都要跟大人商量，请大人做我的靠山。』『那还用说，要人要公事，你尽管开口。』
en: “Second, I fear the troops may seize people for forced labour.” “They will not. I prohibited it long ago. Requisitioned service must be paid for. I can reaffirm the order now: during the busy farming season there must be no disturbance at all, and the farmers must be protected. What else?” “The soldiers may slaughter plough oxen.” “They will not do that either. Whoever kills a plough ox, I shall kill him.” “With such protection, there is hope for this year’s harvest. As for seed and implements, I shall procure them. Whether they are to be lent by the government or sold for cash at fair prices, Your Excellency can settle the rules later. Whatever the decision, it cannot be wrong to have them ready.” “Quite right. Please obtain them—and advance the money too. Apart from money, there is nothing here that cannot be discussed.” “Yes,” Hu replied. “And apart from money, there is nothing I need not discuss with Your Excellency. I ask you to stand behind me.” “Of course. If you need men or official authorisation, you have only to speak.”

zh: 『有件事要跟大人商量。湖州府属的丝，是浙北的命脉；养蚕又是件极麻烦的事，以蚕叫「蚕宝宝」，娇嫩得很，家家关门闭户，轮流守夜，按时喂食，生客上门都不接待的。如今蒋方伯正带兵攻打湖州，大军到处，可能连茶水饭食都不预备；可是这一来，蚕就不能养了。还有，养蚕全靠桑叶，倘或弟兄们砍了桑树当柴烧，蚕宝宝岂不是要活活饿死？』『噢！』左宗棠很注意他，『我平日对经济实用之学，亦颇肯留意；倒不知道养蚕有这么多讲究。照你所说，关系极重；我得赶紧通知蒋芗泉，格外保护。除了不准弟兄骚扰以外，最要防备湖州城里的长毛突围乱窜，扰害养蚕人家。』『大人这么下令，事情就不要紧了！』胡雪岩欣慰地说，『江南是四月里一个月最吃重，唱山歌的话∶』做天难做四月天「，因为插秧、养蚕都在四月里，一个要雨，一个要晴。托朝廷的鸿福，大人的威望，下个月风调雨顺，军务顺手，让这一个月平平安安过去，浙江就可以苦出头了！『』我知道了，总想法子如大家的愿就是。『说到这里，左宗棠眉心打了个结，』倒是有件事，雪翁，我要跟你商量；看看你有没有高招，治那一班蠹吏！『』蠹吏『二字，胡雪岩没有听懂，瞠然不知所答。及至左宗棠作了进一步的解释，才知道指的是京里户部与兵部的书办。
en: “There is one matter to discuss. Silk from the counties of Huzhou is the lifeblood of northern Zhejiang. Raising silkworms is extremely troublesome. They are called ‘silkworm babies’ because they are so delicate. Families shut their doors, take turns watching at night and feed them at fixed hours. They will not even receive unfamiliar visitors. Treasurer Jiang is now leading his forces against Huzhou. Wherever a great army passes, the people may have to prepare tea and food, and then the silkworms cannot be tended. Moreover, silkworms depend entirely on mulberry leaves. If the soldiers cut down the trees for firewood, the creatures will starve.” “Oh!” Zuo listened intently. “I have always taken an interest in practical statecraft, but I did not know that raising silkworms required so much care. As you explain it, the matter is vital. I must tell Jiang Xiangquan at once to provide special protection. Besides preventing interference by our troops, we must above all guard against Longhairs breaking out of Huzhou and scattering through the countryside, harming the silkworm households.” “With such an order, all will be well.” Hu was relieved. “In the lower Yangtze region, the fourth month is the crucial one. As the country song says, ‘It is hard to be Heaven in the fourth month.’ Rice transplanting and silkworm raising both take place then: one needs rain, the other clear skies. With the court’s blessings and Your Excellency’s authority, may next month bring favourable weather and success in the campaign. If we can pass that month in peace, Zhejiang’s suffering can end.” “I understand. I shall do what I can to fulfil everyone’s hopes.” Then Zuo’s brow tightened. “But there is a matter on which I must consult you, Mr Xueyan. Have you a clever way of dealing with those verminous clerks?” Hu did not understand the expression and stared, unable to answer. Only after Zuo explained further did he realise that he meant the clerks in the Ministries of Revenue and War in Beijing.

zh: 『户部与兵部的书办，盼望肃清长毛之心，比谁都殷切；在他们看，平了洪杨，就是他们发财的机会到了。正月廿一，曾老九克了天保城，金陵合围，洪秀全已如釜底游魂。李少荃的淮军，攻克常州，亦是指顾间事；常州一下，淮军长驱西进，会合苦守镇江的冯子材，经丹阳驰援曾九，看起来可以在江宁吃粽子了。』『没有那么快！』胡雪岩接口便答。这一答，使得左宗棠错愕而不悦∶『何以见得？』他问。胡雪岩知道自己答得大率直了。左宗棠有句没有说出来的话∶『莫非论兵我还不如你？因而很见机地改口∶』大人用兵，妙算如神，我何敢瞎议论。不过，我在上海那两年，听到看到，关于李中丞的性情，自以为摸得很透。常州如果攻了下来，他未必肯带兵西进；因为，他不会那么傻，去分曾九帅一心想独得的大功。『』啊！『左宗棠重重一掌，拍在自己大腿上，』你也是这么想？『
en: “The clerks in those two ministries long for the Longhairs’ defeat more eagerly than anyone. To them, the end of the Hong-Yang rebellion means the arrival of their chance to grow rich. On the twenty-first of the first month, Zeng the Ninth took Tianbao Fort. Jinling is encircled, and Hong Xiuquan is like a doomed spirit beneath the cauldron. Li Shaoquan’s Huai Army will take Changzhou before long. Once it falls, that army can sweep west, join Feng Zicai, who has held on so stubbornly at Zhenjiang, and go through Danyang to support Zeng. It seems they may be eating Dragon Boat Festival dumplings in Jiangning.” “Not so soon!” Hu answered immediately. Zuo was startled and displeased. “Why do you say that?” Hu knew he had spoken too bluntly. Zuo had left one question unspoken: “Am I less qualified than you to judge military affairs?” Hu therefore changed his approach at once. “Your Excellency’s conduct of war is inspired. How could I presume to offer a careless opinion? But after two years of seeing and hearing things in Shanghai, I believe I understand Governor Li’s character thoroughly. Even if Changzhou is taken, he may not lead his men west. He is not foolish enough to claim a share of the great victory that Marshal Zeng the Ninth is determined to win alone.” “Ah!” Zuo struck his thigh hard. “You think so too?”
